name: Killmonger

abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.True Strike: Saldırılar Zırh, Direnç, Otomatik Blok ve Kaçışı (Evade) yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Counterpunch: Bir saldırıyı bloklarken şarj harcayarak kısa süreli Unstoppable kazanır ve anında karşı saldırı yapılabilir.
abilityDetails.Reverberation: Vurulduğunda veya bir saldırıyı bloklarken rakibe hasar geri verir.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): %20 kritik direnci var, negatif efekt uygulanınca güç kazanır ve vurulduğunda hasarı geri verir. Zırh kıran veya yetenek azaltıcı şampiyon en iyisi — zırhını kırmak yansıtmayı ve güç kazanımını engeller.
signatureAbility:
Reverberation
Vibranium Armor activates Reverberation for 8 seconds, dealing damage back to the opponent when Killmonger is Struck or Blocks an attack. Damage is based on Killmonger's stored Power at the time of activation, inflicting up to [70 - 155]% of the incoming damage as Physical Damage. Reverberation has a 8 second cooldown time after expiring.
When both Reverberation and True Strike are active, Killmonger gains +[2,011.02 - 11,467.69] Attack Rating when hitting opponents.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: This Champion has additional Critical Resistance in its Base Attributes.

At the start of the fight, Vibranium Armor provides [916.67] Armor Rating and Killmonger gains 15% of his missing Power each time a Debuff is inflicted against him. This Power Gain is not affected by Ability Accuracy modification. Vibranium Armor is disabled if he is suffering from an Armor Break effect.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: Hitting opponents that are recovering from a Special Attack grants Killmonger True Strike for 16 seconds. This allows him to ignore Armor, Resistances, Auto Block and all Evade effects.

abilitySections.title: Critical Hits
content: Critical Hits lacerate opponents with a 80% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff, dealing [3,989.2] damage over 1.5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Killmonger gains 2 Counterpunch Charges that last for 15 seconds. A Charge is spent to gain Unstoppable for 0.75 seconds when Blocking an Attack, allowing him to immediately counter-attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Vibranium Armor activates 3 Indestructible Charges. A charge is spent to ignore all the incoming damage from an attack. Max: 4 charges.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: If Killmonger inflicted 15 or more Bleed Debuffs in this fight, he inflicts a Bleed stack for every Bleed he inflicted. Each Bleed deals [6,482.45] Direct Damage over 6 seconds. This effect can activate once a fight. Max: 50 Bleed stacks.
